SELECT statename, round(sum(try_cast(staff_count AS double))) AS counselors FROM govblock_education.ccd_lea_059 WHERE school_year = (SELECT max(school_year) FROM govblock_education.ccd_lea_059) AND total_indicator = 'Category Set A' AND staff LIKE '%Counselors' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many software packages from Energy Department research are on record?
SELECT count(*) AS software FROM govblock_research.osti_records WHERE product_type = 'Software'
Which states have the most organisations eligible to receive tax-deductible gifts?
SELECT ma AS state, count(*) AS organisations FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_pub78 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did private employment in Clark County, Nevada, change from the second quarter of 2019 to the second quarter of 2020?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT year, try_cast(month3_emplvl AS double) AS jobs FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '32003' AND own_code = '5' AND industry_code = '10' AND qtr = '2' AND year IN ('2019', '2020') ORDER BY 1
Which companies own the most transmission line segments?

SELECT replace(owner, '"', ''), count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_power_transmission_lines WHERE owner NOT LIKE '%NOT AVAILABLE%' AND replace(owner, '"', '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the most solar power the Texas grid produced in one hour in its hourly solar report?
Ercot Hourly Solar Report Cdr Pvgrhrlyavgactnp
SELECT max(try_cast(system_wide_gen AS double)) AS peak_solar_mw FROM govblock_solar.ercot_hourly_solar_report_cdr_pvgrhrlyavgactnp
Which organisations have deposited the most bioassays in PubChem?
SELECT depositorname, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_aid2depositorname WHERE depositorname IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federally qualified health centers are enrolled in Medicare?
SELECT count(DISTINCT npi) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_federally_qualified_health_center_enrollments
Which federal courts have heard the most patent cases?
SELECT court_name, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How large was New York State's labour force in 2024?
SELECT value AS labor_force FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id = 'LAUST360000000000006' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M13'
Which categories of deficiency do nursing home inspectors cite most?
SELECT deficiency_category, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cc_nh_healthcitations WHERE deficiency_category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many meals did drug and device companies buy for doctors in 2019?
SELECT count(*) AS payments FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE nature_of_payment_or_transfer_of_value = 'Food and Beverage' AND cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2019'
Which Senate candidates won the most votes in a single election since 1976?
SELECT concat(candidate, ' (', state_po, ', ', year, ')') AS candidate, try_cast(candidatevotes AS double) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_senate_returns ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What was the Nuclear Waste Fund's balance at the end of fiscal 2024?
SELECT max(try_cast(fiscal_year_amt AS double)) AS balance FROM govblock_treasury.nuclear_waste_fund_results WHERE account_desc LIKE 'Balance Sept%30, 2024'
Which countries are the first filing place for the most published U.S. applications?
SELECT foreign_country_filed AS country, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_foreign_priority GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

Which New York counties have the largest foreign-born share of residents?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B05012_E003' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B05012_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_foreign_born FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US36%' AND a.table_id = 'b05012' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of SureChEMBL's patents come from the European Patent Office?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN country = 'EP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents
Which states have the most Medicare Advantage enrollees?
Ma Enrollment By Contract Plan State County
SELECT state, sum(try_cast(enrollment AS double)) AS enrollees FROM govblock_health.ma_enrollment_by_contract_plan_state_county WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Rhea's pH 7.3 compound mappings were set by hand rather than computed?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN origin = 'curation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_chebi_ph7_3_mapping
Which industrial sectors reported the most greenhouse gas emissions in 2022?

SELECT s.sector_name, sum(try_cast(e.co2e_emission AS double)) AS co2e_tons FROM govblock_environment.ghg_facts_sector_ghg_emission AS e JOIN govblock_environment.ghg_dim_sector AS s ON try_cast(s.sector_id AS double) = try_cast(e.sector_id AS double) WHERE e.year = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many private foundations are registered with the IRS?
SELECT count(*) AS private_foundations FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_eo_bmf WHERE cast(foundation AS varchar) IN ('2', '3', '4')
Which states have the most hospitals beating the national benchmark on C. diff infections?

SELECT state, count(DISTINCT facility_id) AS hospitals FROM govblock_health.cc_healthcare_associated_infections_hospital WHERE measure_id = 'HAI_6_SIR' AND compared_to_national LIKE 'Better%' AND state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the highest total public debt in the Debt to the Penny record?
SELECT max(try_cast(tot_pub_debt_out_amt AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_treasury.debt_to_penny
Which procedures were performed most often during New York hospital stays in 2016?

SELECT ccs_procedure_description, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND ccs_procedure_description <> 'NO PROC' AND ccs_procedure_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many ChEBI compounds carry a negative charge?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_chemical_data WHERE charge < 0
Which companies are named as applicant on the most published patent applications?
SELECT sorted_raw_org AS organisation, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_sorted_org_not_disambiguated WHERE sorted_raw_org <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many facilities in New York State reported toxic releases in 2022?
SELECT count(DISTINCT _2_trifd) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022' AND _8_st = 'NY'
Which kinds of deposits brought the most into the Treasury's cash account in fiscal 2023?

SELECT transaction_catg, try_cast(transaction_fytd_amt AS double) AS millions FROM govblock_treasury.deposits_withdrawals_operating_cash WHERE record_date = '2023-09-29' AND transaction_type = 'Deposits' AND transaction_catg NOT LIKE '%Total%' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What share of patents receive some adjustment to their term?
SELECT round(100.0 * count_if(try_cast(patent_term_adjustment AS double) > 0) / count(*), 1) AS pct_adjusted FROM govblock_patents.patex_pta_summary_25
Which states have retired the most generators?
Eia860 Generator Y Retired And Canceled
SELECT state, count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS retired FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_retired_and_canceled WHERE status = 'RE' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did a kilowatt hour of electricity cost the average household in December 2024?
SELECT value AS dollars_per_kwh FROM govblock_labor.bls_ap_data WHERE series_id = 'APU000072610' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
What kinds of legal documents does the law collection hold most?
SELECT document_type, count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
